user.title: Add a gas station
user.description: Paste a Yandex Maps link to the station (full or short yandex.ru/maps/-/...) or its organization id. Prices come from Yandex.Zapravki and are shown only for Russian IP addresses.

data.station: Yandex Maps link or organization id
data.name: Station name (optional)

error.invalid_station: Could not find an organization id in this link
error.region: Yandex redirected to a foreign domain: prices are only available from a Russian IP (disable VPN/proxy for Home Assistant)
error.captcha: Yandex returned a captcha, try again later
error.no_prices: This station has no fuel prices on Yandex Maps

abort.already_configured: This station and fuel are already added
